i.norm: Verifies that "kSCH" encodes to "C" under the default strict-mode Nysiis encoder. The encoding proceeds as follows: 1. Clean input to uppercase: "KSCH" 2. Leading K -> C (rule 1c): "CSCH" 3. Remaining SCH -> SSS (rule 4f), duplicate S's collapsed, trailing S removed (rule 5) 4. Final result: "C"
